sloka: शोक जालेन महता विततेन न राजतीम् ।सम्सक्ताम् धूम जालेन शिखाम् इव विभावसोः ॥५-१५-३२॥
transliteration: śoka jālena mahatā vitatena na rājatīm ।samsaktām dhūma jālena śikhām iva vibhāvasoḥ ॥5-15-32॥

translations.english: She was like the flames of fire obscured by smoke. She appeared like the text of Smriti of doubtful meaning, a treasure that has been thrown away
